details: Takes the faith as its one argument. Vanilla passes the row's faith (Faith.Self) to show or hide a part of the row.

details: Takes the hegemony title as its one argument. Vanilla passes the row's title (Title.Self) to show or hide a part of the row.

details: Takes the house as its one argument. Vanilla passes the row's house (DynastyHouse.Self) to show or hide a part of the row.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a dynasty house, for example DynastyHouse.Self

label: Is sorting by
summary: Whether the ledger is currently sorted by the named column.
details: Takes the column's widget name as its one argument. Vanilla passes the name of a parent widget to show or press the matching column header.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name that identifies the sort column.
fields.values: a text, in vanilla the name of a widget

label: Is strongest pinned
summary: Whether the given character is pinned in the ledger's strength ranking.
details: Takes the character as its one argument. Vanilla passes the row's character (Character.Self) to show or hide a part of the row.

label: Is war pinned
summary: Whether the given war is pinned in the ledger.
details: Takes the war as its one argument. Vanilla passes the war of the current row (LedgerWarItem.GetWar) to show or hide a part of the row.

label: Sort choice changed
summary: Applies the sort option the user just picked in the ledger's sort list.
details: Vanilla calls it when the selection of the sort list changes; going by its name it applies the new choice. It returns nothing.

label: Open war overview
summary: Opens the overview window of the given war.
details: Takes the war as its one argument. Vanilla calls it from a click with War.Self; going by its name it opens the war's overview. It returns nothing.

label: Reset filters
summary: Puts the ledger's filters back to their defaults.
details: Vanilla calls it from two buttons; going by its name it resets the filters. CanResetFilters is used to show and enable the reset button. It returns nothing.

label: Flip sort order
summary: Switches the ledger's sort between ascending and descending.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click on the sort control, and the sort tooltip says 'Click to toggle'. GetSortOrder tells which direction is active. It returns nothing.

label: This ledger window
summary: The ledger window itself, so it can be passed on to something else.
details: Going by its name and by how the same name is used on other types (for example as an argument like Character.Self), it hands over the object it is called on. Vanilla does not use it on this type.

label: Sort by column
summary: Sorts the ledger by the named column.
details: Takes one text argument. Vanilla calls it from clicks with the clicked widget's own name or its parent's name; going by its name it sorts the ledger by that column. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name that identifies the sort column.
fields.values: a text, in vanilla the name of a widget

details: Takes the artifact as its one argument. Vanilla calls it from a click with Artifact.Self. It returns nothing.
